name: PostgREST
description: Connection info published by a PostgREST API server for consumer applications (Angular SPAs and other clients that call PostgREST). Carries URL and currently-served schemas — no secrets.

provides.name: POSTGREST_URL
provides.description: Full internal URL to PostgREST (e.g. http://postgrest:3000)

provides.name: PGRST_DB_SCHEMAS
provides.description: Comma-separated list of schemas PostgREST currently exposes (auto-discovered from postgres at every postgrest install/reconfigure)
